### Wholehearted Love and Service
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/wholehearted-love-and-service
Passage: Deuteronomy 10:12
Points:
- God has absolute sovereignty over creation and rightfully demands the exclusive allegiance of His people.
- Genuine obedience begins by renouncing all forms of idolatry, false trust, and superstitious practices.
- Indifference toward God provides no middle ground, functioning instead as a subtle form of self-idolatry.
- Wholehearted love and reverence require actively seeking to know God through Scripture and persistent prayer.

### Read the Bible: Deuteronomy 10, Psalm 94, Isaiah 38, and Revelation 8
Author: D. A. Carson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/devotionals/read-the-bible/deut-10-psalm-94-isaiah-38-revelation-8/
Passage: Deuteronomy 10:12-22
Points:
- God-centered living requires uniting holy fear with love, avoiding both paralyzing terror and empty sentimentalism.
- Divine election stems entirely from God's free, sovereign grace over all creation.
- God demands genuine inward transformation of the heart rather than superficial adherence to religious rituals.
- Because the Lord acts with impartial justice toward the vulnerable, His followers must actively love and protect others.
- Continual reflection on God’s mighty deeds preserves believers from self-centeredness and fuels authentic praise.
